description: A test script for handling missing objects in 'git rev-list' command, setting up a test repository, deliberately corrupting objects, and verifying behavior with various missing object scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specific commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after a test.

methods.name: test_oid_to_path
methods.description: Converts an object ID to its corresponding file path in the Git object store.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for differences.

methods.name: test_rev_parse
methods.description: Wraps 'git rev-parse' for parsing object references.
